svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Data lake on AWS
svg.desc: Data lake on AWS. 15 components in 7 groups. Connections: Web and mobile apps to Amazon Data Firehose; Amazon Data Firehose to Raw bucket; Orders database to AWS Database Migration Service; AWS Database Migration Service to Raw bucket; Raw bucket to Clean and convert; Clean and convert to Curated bucket; Curated bucket to Aggregate; Aggregate to Analytics bucket; Analytics bucket to Amazon Athena; Analytics bucket to Amazon Redshift; Amazon Athena to Amazon Quick Sight; Amazon Redshift to Amazon Quick Sight; AWS Glue crawlers to AWS Glue Data Catalog; AWS Lake Formation to AWS Glue Data Catalog; AWS Glue Data Catalog to Amazon Athena (table metadata); AWS Glue Data Catalog to Amazon Redshift (table metadata).

text.tspan: Streaming and database sources land in S3; Glue refines them zone by zone for Athena, Redshift and Quick Sight
